hints: Take logarithms of both sides of $4^{3x-1}=3(5^x)$.
Use the power and product laws to obtain a linear equation in $x$.
Collect the $x$ terms, solve, and round only the final value to 3 decimal places.
walkthrough:
Take the natural logarithm of both sides of the equation $4^{3x - 1} = 3(5^x)$:
$$\ln(4^{3x - 1}) = \ln(3 \cdot 5^x)$$

Apply logarithm laws $\ln(A^B) = B\ln A$ and $\ln(AB) = \ln A + \ln B$ to expand both sides:
$$(3x - 1)\ln 4 = \ln 3 + \ln(5^x)$$
$$(3x - 1)\ln 4 = \ln 3 + x\ln 5$$

Expand the left-hand side and group terms containing $x$:
$$3x\ln 4 - \ln 4 = \ln 3 + x\ln 5$$
$$3x\ln 4 - x\ln 5 = \ln 3 + \ln 4$$

Factor out $x$ on the left-hand side and combine terms on the right-hand side:
$$x(3\ln 4 - \ln 5) = \ln(3 \times 4) = \ln 12$$

Rewrite $3\ln 4 = \ln(4^3) = \ln 64$, giving the coefficient of $x$ as $\ln 64 - \ln 5 = \ln\left(\dfrac{64}{5}\right) = \ln 12.8$:
$$x\ln 12.8 = \ln 12$$

Evaluate the numerical quotient using logarithms:
$$x \approx \dfrac{2.484907}{2.549445} \approx 0.974685$$

Round the solution to 3 decimal places:
$$x = 0.975$$

ai_rubric.Solving Exponential and Logarithmic Equa: Applies law of the logarithm of a product, power or quotient; Derives a linear equation, e.g. $(3x-1)\ln4=\ln3+x\ln5$; Concludes with $x=0.975$.
